title: Your Credit Card Has $1,200 in Benefits You Never Use
hook: That card in your wallet has travel insurance, cell phone coverage, and purchase protection most people never touch — worth over $1,200 a year.
angle: Instead of a 'you're being tricked' angle, this is 'you're leaving free money behind' — contrarian because it's about benefits hiding on a card people already own
audience: Anyone with a credit card, especially people who pay annual fees and never look past the rewards points
key_numbers: 73% of cardholders have never filed a single benefit claim
